evidence.source: The paper establishes the relevant pathway classes and a multi-step TS/IRC computational protocol. (page 5, block 7 and page 9, block 6)
The source defines charged doublet models without OH and neutral singlet models with OH, and validates TSs by IRC. (page 9, block 6)
The source reports that chain length changes alpha-cation stabilization, rearrangement/quenching and dehydrogenation behavior. (page 5, blocks 4 and 7)
